Home.promise: Find seasonal work with housing, meals, pay & a place — upfront.
Home.sub: Free forever for seekers. Hosts pay for visibility — you never pay to find work.

Meta.homeTitle: Explore & Earn — Seasonal jobs with housing, meals & pay upfront
Meta.homeDescription: Discover seasonal work in places worth living — farms, coasts, resorts, and remote roles. Every opportunity answers the three questions that matter before you apply: where you'll sleep, what you'll eat, and what you'll earn.
Meta.homeOgDescription: A discovery marketplace for seasonal work and real-world exploration. Housing, meals, and pay — answered on every listing.
